envelope.description: Add Scope, ValidationResult and ScopeFieldRequirement types

body.title: Add Scope, ValidationResult and ScopeFieldRequirement types
body.summary: Add interface Scope {scopeType, scopeLevel, def?, hld?, lld?, plan?, tasks?, extension?, amendment?}, type ScopeType/ScopeLevel, interface ValidationResult {ok, violations}, type ScopeValidator, and the internal (non-exported) ScopeFieldRequirement declarative table shape to src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts, beside Story s1's Locator/Pointer. Every named Scope field is independently typed (never a generic map), per k1.
acceptanceChecks: Scope, ScopeType, ScopeLevel, ValidationResult and ScopeValidator are exported from types.ts with exactly sc3's interfaceSketch field shapes (readonly, optional-with-undefined per repo convention)
A Scope with distinct def/hld/lld/plan/tasks/extension/amendment Pointers keeps each field independently addressable (no generic map)
tsc --noEmit passes with the new types in place

tests.name: Scope, ScopeType, ScopeLevel, ValidationResult and ScopeValidator are exported with the exact documented field shapes
